meta.title: GALA Yuzawa Snow Resort
meta.description: 0 min from Joetsu Shinkansen Gala Yuzawa Station — 16 courses, 823 m vertical, day-trip snow resort. Après at onsen town and Ponshu-kan.

transit.title:
Ticket gate to
the slopes.
transit.lead: 0 minutes from Joetsu Shinkansen Gala Yuzawa Station to ski center Kawabanga — Tokyo in ~70 minutes, hands-free Shinkansen, rental-to-gondola in one building. Finish at GALA no Yu spa or Echigo-Yuzawa onsen town.
transit.imgAlt: Gala Yuzawa Station directly linked to the ski center — from ticket gate to snow

primary.title: Japan's ultimate station link
primary.lead: Step off the Shinkansen into the ski center — no snowy drives, no heavy bags. Built for day-trip snow with friction stripped from every step of the journey.
primary.imgAlt: Long run and Minamiuonuma snow mountain panorama at GALA Yuzawa

secondary.title: After skiing, onsen town
secondary.lead: From in-resort GALA no Yu spa to Yuzawa onsen village via ropeway — Komako-no-Yu and Ponshu-kan fit naturally into an afternoon loop.

onsen.title:
GALA no Yu &
Echigo-Yuzawa baths
onsen.lead: Day-use spa inside the ski center plus 800-year onsen town soto-yu — recovery and street walks on one après line.
onsen.whisper: Public baths are local community spaces. Rinse before soaking and check official hours before visiting.
onsen.imgAlt: GALA no Yu hot spring with snowy mountain view

gala-no-yu.title: SPA GALA no Yu
gala-no-yu.lead: Day-use baths inside GALA ski center — rinse off right after your last run. Hours and fees: check official site. TEL 025-785-6543 (main).
gala-no-yu.imgAlt: GALA no Yu day spa inside the ski center

komako.title: Komako-no-Yu public bath
komako.lead: Yuzawa 148. Iconic communal bath in the onsen street — Snow Country atmosphere. TEL 025-785-7660.

hatago.title: HATAGO Isen
hatago.lead: Yuzawa 2455. Ryokan known for Uonuma Koshihikari and local cuisine — day-use and foot baths: check official site. TEL 0120-85-0039.
hatago.imgAlt: HATAGO Isen ryokan and foot bath in Yuzawa

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning Shinkansen to GALA → afternoon ropeway lunch at Yuzawa Kogen → Komako-no-Yu → dinner at Ninjin-tei → sake tasting at Ponshu-kan.

shinkansen.title: 0 min from Gala Yuzawa Station
shinkansen.body: ~70 minutes from Tokyo — ticket gate to Kawabanga ski center. Rental, lockers, and gondola in one seamless day-trip snow line.

falcon.title: Falcon 2,500 m long run
falcon.body: 2,500 m downhill, max 20° — panoramic Tanigawa peaks over Minamiuonuma. Plus Grenoble summit views and Super Swan off-piste on 16 varied courses.

yuzawa-town.title: Echigo-Yuzawa deep loop
yuzawa-town.body: Expand with Yuzawa Snow Link to Yuzawa Kogen and Ishiuchi Maruyama — then shift to town baths and Ponshu-kan for a full-area day beyond resort-only stays.
